title: Token part of a documented {email_address}/token:{api_token} Basic credential string
summary: A synthetic token after the /token: separator of an email-address username in a curl -u argument, a JSON configuration string and an environment assignment, for a Zendesk subdomain.
rationale: The documented credential string is {email_address}/token:{api_token}, and Zendesk calls the token a password that can impersonate anyone in the account, so the literal /token: after an email address marks where the secret part begins. Zendesk states no length, alphabet or prefix, so the token is flagged because of where it sits, not because of its shape. The extent is the token only: the email address, the /token separator and any quote are outside it, and the email address is an identifier whose confidentiality Zendesk does not state. The Basic header form carries the same string base64-encoded; that representation is a separate question and no fixture here encodes it. The family is deprecated and being retired in phases through 2027-04-30, and a retired credential still sits in configuration and scripts until it is removed.

expectation.rationale: Project policy, maintainer-only (ADR 0020, credential-evidence#246). Finalized by the sole maintainer alone: not reviewed, not independent validation, queued for retro-review (#154). The question, options, strongest dissent and reversing evidence are in the review history. Flagged under project policy: the part after /token: in an email-address-and-token Basic credential string is treated as a credential whatever its shape. Zendesk documents the composition and calls the token a password (existence of the carrier only); the value admission, extent and attribution are the project's decisions, and no prefix, width or alphabet is claimed.

sources.supports: API tokens are auto-generated passwords in the Zendesk Admin Center. ... Basic authentication is used for API tokens. ... Use the following format for the credentials: {email_address}/token:{api_token}
Existing API tokens continue to work until April 30, 2027, unless they become inactive first.

notes: Project-authored by the Redact Secret project, which maintains this repository; not independent evidence. Draft; not yet reviewed. All values are synthetic, were built for this record and were not tested against any service. The carrier's existence is what the cited provider pages document; the value admission, span, placeholder handling and attribution are project policy. Parser behaviour, action and product attribution stay with the downstream repositories.
